provenance: Sanitized summary of reference-device test records dated 2026-10-21. Original records are excluded from the public repository.

display.helper: Black background, muted green text and outlined controls
display.system_settings: Black background, muted green large switch; verified in a freshly restarted Settings process

presets.verification: Clicked enabled controls using device UI hierarchy; read back settings system screen_brightness after each action

supported_actions: Apply all or toggle logging/light idle/system colors individually
helper_system_controls.background: Boot/package receiver and bounded existing Wi-Fi checks; no persistent polling service
helper_system_controls.privileged_execution: Fixed helper commands through existing localhost ADB and system su; does not require a host adb root before automatic boot apply

limits: No controlled long-duration battery-life comparison; CPU and file-write observations do not establish a battery-life percentage.
Phone-side voice/Bluetooth workflows were not interactively exercised; original services and the camera HAL remain registered/running.
Helper 1.7 validation used an empty photo list; preview, export and deletion were not regression-tested in that version.
Screenshots and resource values establish rendered UI changes, not measured optical output.
Fresh consumer-device initial ADB enablement is not established.
Other regions, hardware SKUs, bootloader-locked devices and firmware starting points are not qualified.
No firmware downgrade or recovery-flashing route was tested.
No current live-device state is implied by historical observations.
